cta_caption: Comment SWITCH aur main full guide DM kar dunga 📩

slides.headline: BUSINESS YA [CREATOR]
slides.label: SHORT ANSWER
lines: DM automation ke liye **Business** ya **Creator** account. Switch **free** hai.

slides.headline: [CREATOR] KAUN?
slides.label: CHOOSE
lines: **Creator**: influencers, artists, coaches. **Business**: shops, brands, services.

slides.headline: DONO [CHALTE] HAIN
slides.label: GOOD NEWS
lines: Dono comment-to-DM aur **AI agent** ke saath chalte hain. **Wapas switch** bhi kar sakte ho.

slides.headline: PHIR [CONNECT] KARO
slides.label: THEN
lines: **Continue with Instagram**, Instagram ki screen pe approve. **Password** kabhi share nahi.

slides.headline: FOLLOWERS [SAFE]?
slides.label: FAQ
lines: Haan, **followers same** rehte hain. **Facebook page** bhi zaroori nahi.
